subject.title: build(ui): raise control-ui startup baseline for landed sidebar work

question: Should the protected Control UI startup-size guard adopt 320696 B as the reviewed post-landing baseline once the canonical performance check confirms that measurement?
rationale: The patch changes merge-gate enforcement rather than product behavior, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the submitted evidence is plausible.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Verify the canonical production-build measurement is 320696 B and accept this bounded 434 B baseline update.

options.title: Hold the old baseline
options.body: Keep the 320262 B reference if the expected CI measurement cannot be reproduced or the recent growth should instead be reduced in the contributing UI work.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Verify the canonical production-build measurement is 320696 B and accept this bounded 434 B baseline update.
